data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"Popper's preference for the better-corroborated theory in action is defensible without smuggling in induction if re-framed as a 'critical selection' of the most informative potential falsifier, where the cost is accepting that this preference offers no guarantee of future success or increased probability of truth, only a rational alignment with the aim of science (verisimilitude) despite the formal impossibility of measuring it.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If the agent requires a probabilistic guarantee of success for action, Popper's framework fails.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If 'verisimilitude' cannot be coherently defined without probabilistic assumptions (per Tich\u00fd/Miller), the rational basis for preference collapses.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the distinction between 'psychological expectation' and 'rational preference' is deemed insufficient to guide high-stakes action.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the problem demands a positive justification for why the un-falsified theory will hold in novel domains, rather than just a negative justification of eliminating competitors.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"The mechanism distinguishes between 'justification for belief' (which Popper rejects as inductive) and 'rational choice for action' based on the current state of critical discussion. By selecting the theory that has survived the severest tests, we select the one that currently best approximates truth (highest verisimilitude) not because past success predicts future success (induction), but because it is the only one not yet known to be false, making it the most informative starting point for further error elimination. This treats action as an extension of the critical method rather than a leap of faith.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
